limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the divider selection but also changed the pulse-width rule for parameter overrides; for example, a divisor of 2 now gives one high cycle instead of the two preserved by the reference fix.
The test checked the rewritten half-period rule, so it passed without detecting that the patch changed the original output timing for parameter overrides.
The agent had to submit the simulation command three times because the first attempt used a rejected cleanup command and the second hit a testbench syntax error before the design could be exercised.
